title: Cubic augmentation of a two-moment model: an exact finite absorption theorem and its limits
summary: We study adjoining a half-bandwidth signed cubic trace and a spectral count ladder to a bandwidth-one trace/Frobenius model motivated by zeta-zero certificates. In a finite circle model with mass N = 64, flat windows, and explicit budget centers, we prove exact absorption over the full atom-only class: the augmented and baseline optima agree for both the distinct-count and simple-fraction objectives. Three explicitly specified integer-marked grid columns attain the lower bounds. Their mixing weights are defined algebraically, and an Arb certificate proves all strict feasibility and inertia…
